bugs.title: Motor never turns off when level falls below 20 cm
bugs.description: The state machine in loop() only has transitions IDLE->FILL (line 73) and FILL->RUN (line 77); there is no branch that leaves ST_RUN when levelCm drops below RUN_MIN_CM, so once in RUN the motor stays HIGH indefinitely. Measured evidence confirms this: in the nominal ramp D10 was not HIGH for 3550 ms while required (t=2.53 s to 6.08 s), and in the drain scenario D10 was not LOW for 660 ms starting at 11.34 s, exceeding the 600 ms grace. The RUN_MIN_CM constant (line 11) is declared but never used. D10 was in the wrong state for 3550 ms across 1 interval(s), first at 2.53 s: D10 was not HIGH for 3550 ms while required (grace 600 ms).
